text_simplified: Parents must instill reverence, love, and monotheism for Allah the Exalted in the hearts of young children, protect them from creedal errors such as amulets, charms, and palm-reading, and accustom them to enjoining good and forbidding evil. Parents should not assume that a young child cannot understand guidance; the Prophet ﷺ educated al-Hasan ibn Ali (may Allah be pleased with them both) when he took a date from charity by saying to him: "Kakh, kakh!" so he would cast it out, and then saying: "Did you not know that we do not eat charity?" (Sahih al-Bukhari 1491). Parents must also restrain anger, seek refuge in Allah from Satan, and favor encouragement over punishment.
